servinfo.title: EBD Warning Light (Brake Warning Light) Does Not Come ON after Setting Ignition “ON”

servinfosub.title: System Description
servinfosub.ptxt: Refer to “System Description” under EBD Warning Light (Brake Warning Light) Comes ON Steady .

testgroup.title: Warning light check
testgroup.question: Does ABS warning light stay on?

action.ptxt: Go to ESP® Warning Light Comes ON Steady .

Replace combination meter and recheck warning light operation. If EBD warning light (brake warning light) does not come ON, replace ESP® hydraulic unit / control module assembly and recheck warning light operation.
